answer: Require each operator to renew identity yearly with an in-person notary who seals a fresh attestation after checking government ID. The network treats that seal as one vertex of voting power, and an atlas of seal serials flags duplicate notaries reused across a farm. Ink pigment and seal geometry are logged so forged stamps fail checks. At about $75 per notarization, minting 400 clones costs roughly $30,000 a year, and notaries who mass-seal strangers lose their accreditation.
